prize.text: Free-entry events show published pools of $40 (split $32/$8) and $120; pools are adjusted by eligible teams. Paid 'Elite' events pay more ($1,500) but charge an entry fee.
prize.quote: ENTRY/PLAYER Free Entry ... Final prize will be adjusted ...

freeEntry.text: Free entry is explicit on the page and in each free tournament title.
freeEntry.quote: Totally free to enter with real cash prizes. New tournaments posted daily.

deadline.text: Rolling: multiple free tournaments per day, posted a day ahead
deadline.quote: Nov 1 2026, 05:30 PM EST | Nov 2 2026, 01:30 PM EST

eligibility.text: 4v4, up to 256 teams, 18+; US residents unless stated; prize claims barred in AZ, HI, IA, MS, MT, NV and SD. The event header also lists NA + EU, which conflicts with the US-default legal terms.
eligibility.quote: 18+; general rules US residents unless otherwise stated. Prize exclusions: AZ, HI, IA, MS, MT, NV, SD.

aiPolicy.quote: Not addressed on the free tournament page.

payout.quote: Payout methods are not described on the free tournament page.

summary: Genuine free-entry cash tournaments, refreshed daily, mostly Call of Duty 4v4 SnD. Small prizes ($40-$120) and you must actually be good at the game; free cash entry is confirmed by the operator.
flags: Prize-claim window is stated as both 24 hours and seven days on the same page - unresolved.
Region label (NA + EU) conflicts with US-default legal terms.
Prize barred in AZ, HI, IA, MS, MT, NV, SD.
Not every listed event is free: the directory also shows paid 'Elite' events.
The ledger's '$10-$180 cash per tournament' was not reproduced: free-entry prizes observed were $40, $120 and one $100 invite-only event; the $1,500 event is paid entry.
